title: AutoFix with ChatGPT — Language-Specific Code Patches
goal: Replace the 4 hardcoded AutoFix templates with real ChatGPT-generated remediation code that is specific to the finding type, the detected technology stack, and the actual vulnerable endpoint context.
scope: Extend the existing autofix service (api/app/services/autofix.py). Add a ChatGPTOAuthAutoFixProvider alongside the existing DeterministicAutoFixProvider. When ChatGPT OAuth is configured and a finding has evidence_ref pointing to task output, call ChatGPT with: (1) finding title and description, (2) CWE and CVSS references if available, (3) detected technology stack from the run inventory snapshot (e.g. Python/Django, Java/Spring, Node.js/Express detected from HTTP headers or fingerprints), (4) the vulnerable HTTP request/response from the artifact (first 500 chars), (5) prompt: generate a specific remediation code snippet for {technology_stack} that fixes this {finding_type}. Keep it under 20 lines. Include the import or config change needed. Store the AI-generated fix as FindingRemediation.ai_fix_suggestion (add this text field to FindingRemediation model). In the Findings drawer, show the AI-generated fix under a Suggested Fix section with a clearly labeled AI-generated banner and disclaimer: This is an AI-generated suggestion. Review before applying. Do not apply to production without testing. The existing DeterministicAutoFixProvider remains as fallback when ChatGPT is not configured.
generation_reason: The AutoFix service has 4 hardcoded generic templates that are not specific to the actual technology being tested. Real ChatGPT-generated fixes that know the stack (Django vs Spring vs Express) deliver immediate value to developers.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Advisory fix suggestions only. Never auto-apply fixes. Prominent disclaimer required. No code execution.

success_criteria: ChatGPT-generated fix shown in Findings drawer when provider configured.
Fix is technology-stack specific (different for Django vs Spring vs Node.js).
AI-generated banner and disclaimer always shown with the fix.

acceptance_criteria: ChatGPT fix generated and stored. Shown in drawer with disclaimer. Deterministic fallback unchanged.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
